# Helvety

> Helvety software products engineered, designed and made in Switzerland. Private, simple, clean. Web apps, legal pages, and Store links for the full product line.

## Canonical URLs
- [Home](https://helvety.com): Main landing page
- [Privacy Policy](https://helvety.com/privacy): Current privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://helvety.com/terms): Terms governing service use
- [Impressum](https://helvety.com/impressum): Legal company information

## Crawling And Indexing
- Public pages are intended to be indexable by search and AI crawlers.
- Private app routes are not intended as search index targets and use noindex and auth-gated controls.

## Cookies And Telemetry
- Helvety web zones use essential and authentication cookies, browser storage for preferences, and privacy-focused Vercel Analytics on all ten Next.js apps (Speed Insights on the main site). Full disclosure: [Privacy Policy §9](https://helvety.com/privacy#cookies).

## Related apps and tools
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store): Specs plus .sppkg / ZIP artifacts straight from the catalog
- [Helvety SPO Explorer](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-spo-explorer): SharePoint site switcher in the header
- [Power Platform Configurator](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-power-platform-configurator): Configure Power Automate cloud flows: Classic or New Designer. Hide the survey prompt by default. Pause anytime. Survey tab: optional v3survey control. Hide (default) sets false on rewrites; Show only normalizes when already present. Paused: no URL rewrites while the extension stays installed.
- [Helvety Screen Tools](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-screen-tools): Windows screenshots and on-screen drawing
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): Merge, reorder, rotate, and extract PDF pages in the browser
- [Helvety Docs](https://helvety.com/docs): Edit Word (.docx) in the browser; optional encrypted vault save
- [Helvety Image Upscaler](https://helvety.com/image-upscaler): Upscale images in the browser on your device
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts): Encrypted address book with export tooling
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/notes): Encrypted notes in Personal, Work, and Other groups
- [Helvety Links](https://helvety.com/links): Encrypted bookmarks in nested folders
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks): Encrypted stage-based task board

## Licensing
All Helvety products with published source are released under AGPL-3.0 or later (including browser extensions, SharePoint solutions, and desktop tools distributed outside this repository).

## Source
- [GitHub - helvety.com monorepo](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Web applications and shared packages (AGPL-3.0)
